newsitem.title: USA: Boeing sees 747-600 launch within 6 months.
newsitem.headline: Boeing sees 747-600 launch within 6 months.

text.p: Boeing Co commercial airplane group president Ron Woodard said on Thursday he expects the stretched 747-600X jumbo jet to be launched within six months.

"I would guess we are going to have the program launched in the next two to six months roughly," Woodard told Reuters in Dallas, where he was attending a ceremony announcing a large new contract with AMR Corp's American Airlines.

"We right now are working with our potential customers to see exactly when they want that airplane," he said. "We've made firm proposals ... It's a great airplane and I think we are going to be launching it sometime in the near future."

Woodard said customer reaction to the 747-600X, which has capacity for about 100 passengers more than the current 747 jumbo jet, has been "good." But he said carriers were not clear on how many big airplanes with more than 500 seats they might need.
He said Boeing sees a market of 400 to 500 such planes over the next 20 years, while Airbus Industrie executives think the market will be 1,300 to 1,500 planes.
"If we are right, and we firmly believe we are, demand is very slight and airlines can't afford to go buy a bunch of them if the marketplace doesn't support it," Woodard said.
